title: kith-store: get_changes_since (Message) returns all changes as added[], never updated[]
description: MessageStore::get_changes_since comments 'Phase 1: all changes are reported as added; no distinction between creates and updates'. This means a delivery state change (pending→delivered) or a read receipt update appears in Message/changes created[] — the client is told the message is new. RFC 8620 requires updated[] for mutations of existing objects. The companion method get_changes_since_ordered correctly classifies via created_at_version. But get_changes_since is the method called by kith-jmap MessageChangesHandler when maxChanges is not set. This is a confirmed protocol bug: any message state update will appear as a creation in the response.
